headline: Senior Software Engineer | Cloud-Native Backend & Applied AI
summary: Senior software engineer (6 years) building secure, scalable backend systems and, more recently, practical applied-AI tooling. Strong across Java/Spring and Python services, Kubernetes and DevOps, and LLM application work (agents, RAG, prompt engineering). Known for turning constraints into leverage -- shipping reliable systems and automation that pay for themselves.

bullets: Built an internal AI test-generation agent that produced ~20,000 lines of tests across 40+ modules, cutting manual QA effort ~70% with zero production incidents.
Shipped a multi-provider LLM prompt toolkit adopted across three teams, standardizing model selection, prompt patterns, and a lightweight evaluation harness.
Added retrieval-augmented (RAG) answers over an internal knowledge base, reducing support escalations ~25% and cutting median time-to-answer roughly in half.
Re-architected a monolithic batch service into decoupled microservices on Kubernetes, migrating with zero downtime across two consecutive releases.
Designed SLA-based alerting and self-healing retries that moved an on-call rota from reactive firefighting to proactive operation.
Delivered a secrets-rotation integration (least-privilege IAM, atomic rotation) that removed hard-coded credentials from the deployment path.
Built Java and Spring Boot backend services and REST APIs serving 40+ enterprise clients, owning data models, migrations, and release pipelines.
Cut CI build time ~55% and reduced cloud cost ~30% through right-sized autoscaling and container image slimming.
Led an SVN-to-Git migration and introduced trunk-based development with automated checks, improving release cadence.
Mentored two junior engineers and owned onboarding runbooks, improving ramp-up time and code-review quality.
Built the responsive front-end for an internal analytics dashboard (React, TypeScript), improving first-load performance ~15% via code-splitting.
